results.title: JobCopilot is rated "Poor" with 2.1 / 5 on Trustpilot
results.content:
Considering 66 reviews, most reviewers were unhappy with their experience overall. Customers struggled heavily with the monthly subscription model, noting that cancelling their accounts was extremely difficult and automated job applications completely failed to deliver interviews. People also mentioned that the artificial intelligence generated inaccurate resume information, poor job matching, and incorrectly applied to completely irrelevant roles. However, some customers also noted that the platform saved time by automating repetitive tasks, streamlining the entire job search, and providing a clean interface. Consumers found that tracking every application was very useful, and they appreciated that the support team responded promptly to address their questions.See more [...] Advertisement

## My experience with JobCopilot has been negative and frustrating
My experience with JobCopilot has been extremely disappointing. The service offers little genuine value and, in my experience, is worse than LinkedIn Premium.  
  
It feels like yet another platform using “AI” as a marketing label while charging users for results that do not justify the cost. I found the service ineffective and regret paying for it.  
  
I would not recommend JobCopilot. Jobseekers deserve transparent, useful tools—not more expensive AI hype.
